questions.ask: Could you please tell me your date of birth?
Could you please tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and we record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain why I am calling once I know I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: At what time could I reach them?
lines.tp_outside_window: I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00. Is there another time that works?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. I will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: The security questions protect your account, so that I only speak with you. Could you answer them, please?
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I cannot continue.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, I did not catch that. Could you say it again, please?
lines.id_wrong: That does not match our records. Could you try again, please?
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, {title} {last_name}. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: Could you pay {amount} on {date}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.offer_floor: I understand. Could you pay {amount} instead? The rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount. The lowest amount I can accept is {amount}. Could you pay that?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, the lowest amount I can accept is {amount}.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Could you choose today or a later date?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. Could you pay on {date} instead?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read that back to you.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can use is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can help with that.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with first?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

assumptions: The brief does not name a currency, so currency_word uses the default 'dollars'.
Workdays are Monday to Friday, [0,1,2,3,4] (section 7). Holidays are the five Freya Bank dates in section 7.
Rule 22: 'next <weekday>' means that weekday in the following calendar week, so date_rules.next_weekday = following_week.
Rule 3: if confirmation is still unclear after the second ask, the call closes as not_reached/unclear, so confirm.max_asks = 2.

Rules 6-7: callback is today or the next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, later than now. One more ask after a bad time, so callback.max_asks = 2. The brief does not require 'today' to be a business day, so business_days_only = false.
Rule 1 says to state that the call is recorded. The spec format requires active voice, so the opening says 'we record this call'.
Identity order (rule 11): date_of_birth (sent as YYYY-MM-DD), then phone_last4 (4 digits). The field values come from the verify_identity enum. Numeric-only dates are read day-month-year (dmy).

Rule 12: three wrong answers in total end the check, so max_wrong = 3. Rule 13: a day_month_swapped hint asks for the month as a word and does not count as a wrong answer. The hint line asks for the whole date of birth again, with the month as a word, because the retry is a new verify_identity call that needs a full YYYY-MM-DD date.

Rule 15: asking what the call is about counts as declining (why_is_decline = true). Other questions, such as robot or scam questions, are answered and do not count as declining (question_is_decline = false).

Rule 17: product names are 'credit card ending {card_last4}', 'personal loan' and 'car loan'. Rule 25: the floor is minimum_payment for credit cards and instalment_amount for loans. The amount owed is past_due.
Bands come from rule 18: early is 1-7 days late, with the 12th business day as deadline and 1 attempt. Late is 8-45 days late, with the 7th business day as deadline and 2 attempts.

Ladder from rule 30: attempt 1 is the full amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much, on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, the engine uses the last business day of next week. Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
Rules 23, 26 and 27: refusing the deadline, refusing the offered floor, or refusing the floor after a below-floor amount is a flat refusal, so refuse_deadline_is_refusal = true.
The brief says 'Brief A never uses add_note', so notes.enabled = false. The note values in events are taken from the add_note reason enum for completeness only.
Brief A covers only one product, so the multi settings keep their defaults.
Rule 42: the agent asks once whether it can help before transferring to a human (ask_first = true). The general queue is used for human transfers.
Rule 45: saying twice 'I don't want to talk' ends the call (max_not_talk = 2). After verification it closes as no_promise/refused, before verification as not_verified/declined.
Rule 32 (hardship) comes before rules 30 and 41. The support transfer uses queue 'support' and closes as transferred/support. If the customer declines, it closes as no_promise/hardship.
Rule 39: the paid outcome has no reason, and the promise outcome has no reason. If a transfer follows a recorded promise, the call closes as transferred with that transfer's reason (section 12).
Rule 37: if create_promise fails, the agent retries once. If it fails again, the call closes as no_promise/service_error.
Rule 36: if the customer asks to change a recorded promise, the agent tells them they can change it in the mobile app. No separate line key exists for this.

Prescribed wording is used exactly: 'Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?', 'I am sorry for your loss.', 'Can you make this payment today?', 'Do you confirm?' and 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
Tool body field names come from the OpenAPI file: field/answer, product_id/amount/date, product_id/reason, date/time, queue, outcome/reason.
